payload.summary: The ui-tools forms-sorting spec ranks with interpretNaturalLanguage off while the page ranks with it on
payload.detail: tests/ui-tools.spec.ts 'result sorting persists in the URL and restores through browser history' is red on main. It built its relevance expectation as the hardcoded slug 'transport-crisis-form' and its A-Z expectation from rankFormRecords(formRecords, 'transport forms') - the four-argument form, leaving interpretNaturalLanguage at its false default. Every production caller passes true (src/components/forms/forms-search-results-page.tsx:634, src/components/clinical-dashboard/use-deferred-registry-search.ts:44, src/app/api/registry/records/route.ts:53), so page and spec ranked the same query by different rules. Reproduced against the isolated production build: expected form-search-result-transport-crisis-form, received form-search-result-detention-examination-movement. It failed identically on PRs #2697, #2698 and #2699, none of which touch forms search. The fix (derive both expectations from the same five-argument call) is carried by all three; close this row once whichever lands first carries it to main.
